risks.title: Energy Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned in the central section of market disclosures with material impact language ('may continue to adversely affect our profitability'). Quantified exposure: 6-8 million MMBtu/year of natural gas, impact of $6-8M per dollar/MMBtu. Stable trend but geopolitical factors explicitly mentioned. Moderate-weight macroeconomic category.

risks.title: Raw Material Price Volatility
risks.score_rationale: Risk in central section with material impact language ('could limit our ability'). Massive exposure: 70 million pounds of nickel/year, impact of $70M per dollar/pound. Pass-through delays mentioned. Minor hedging (less than 5% of annual needs). Stable trend but high structural exposure.

risks.title: Goodwill Impairment Risk
risks.score_rationale: Risk identified as a 'Critical Audit Matter' by the independent auditor (high importance ranking). Material amount: $225 million of goodwill on the balance sheet. Complex assessment language involving subjective judgments on discount rates. Stable trend but annual assessment required. High-weight capital category for analysts.

risks.title: Counterparty Risk on Financial Derivatives
risks.score_rationale: Risk mentioned in the risk management section with monitoring language ('monitor the third-party financial institutions... on a daily basis'). Exposure to third-party financial institutions for derivative contracts. Diversification mentioned as mitigating. Stable trend with controls in place. Moderate-weight credit category.

risks.title: Foreign Exchange Risk on International Transactions
risks.score_rationale: Risk in the risk management section with moderate language ('from time-to-time'). Current exposure low: no significant forward contracts outstanding as of December 28, 2025. Net gains/losses of $2.6M in 2025 vs $2.2M in 2024 (immaterial). Stable trend with reduced exposure. Moderate-weight macro category.
